summary.en: Baidu's cloud storage client. Linaro's catalog lists it as working under x64 emulation.
summary.zh-TW: 百度網盤雲端硬碟用戶端。Linaro 資料庫列為以 x64 轉譯執行可運作。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Only Linaro's catalog (tested on a Qualcomm device, 2026-03-02) was found; no vendor statement.
caveats.zh-TW: 只找到 Linaro 資料庫的紀錄（2026-03-02 在高通裝置上測試），沒有原廠說明。
